description: A living Human Design bodygraph as a navigable world. Users explore their own psyche through cities (centers), buildings (gates), and scenarios (I Ching hexagrams).

body_map.description: The Human Design chart rendered as a world map

klein_processors.AutoLink: Natural language parser and semantic interface
klein_processors.DISEMINER: Pattern detection and life insight engine
klein_processors.WorldEngine: 3D world builder from I Ching symbols

genome_agents.description: Autonomous agents that traverse the body, carry messages, and spawn MCP tools
genome_agents.placeholder_for: Original Gene Gnomes from user's previous build

mcp_hub.description: External tool integration - genomes spawn these as needed

user_flow: 1. User opens app - sees their Synthia Body (Human Design chart as world map)
2. Centers glow based on defined/undefined (bright = defined, dim = undefined)
3. Genomes travel along channels (glowing paths with traffic)
4. User clicks a center → zooms into that city (3D environment)
5. User clicks a gate → enters a scenario (Sims-like skit)
6. Scenario is personalized based on user's patterns (DISEMINER)
7. User makes choices, learns lessons, outcome feeds back to system
8. Body map evolves - new areas glow, channels brighten, genomes multiply

mobile_compatibility.frontend: WebGL/Unity (can run in browser or native app)
mobile_compatibility.notes: Designed to run on low-resource mobile devices
